6. The Appellant was convicted and sentenced for twenty (20) years and fined for the aforenoted offences.

7. Admit.

9.

CRL.M.(BAIL) 15/2025 (under section 430 of BNSS 2023 read with section 528 of BNSS 2023 seeking suspension of sentence and release of the appellant on bail during the pendency of the instant appeal)
10. This application has been filed seeking regular suspension of sentence pending disposal of the appeal.
The Appellant has been in custody since 31.05.2024.
11. Issue notice.
Learned APP accepts notice on behalf of the State.
12. The status report be filed before the next date of hearing.

13. The Appellant's counsel shall file two (2) page note bulleting the contentions in support of the relief of suspension of sentence with reference to pdf pages of court file and list of citations they wish to rely upon.
This shall be placed on record prior to the next date of hearing.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

Considering the nature of the offence, the Investigating Officer ('IO') will inform the prosecutrix/complainant in writing regarding the pendency of the matter to enable them to be present in the Court personally or through authorized representative/counsel, if they so desire.
It is clarified that it is not compulsory the prosecutrix/complainant to appear in person.
15. The proof of the said intimation shall be placed by the Respondent before this Court.
